authority: Standing autonomous CNY10000 mandate; same-researcher decision, not independent human approval.
mechanism: Elevated geopolitical threats may sustain precautionary demand for physical-gold exposure beyond the initial news response. The papers distinguish threats from realized acts; persistence of gold demand is our hypothesis. Immediate pricing, dissipation, USD/RMB changes and execution costs can invalidate the future-return direction; no paper establishes this ETF rule.
distinction: Uses author-published geopolitical threat article shares and publication-version metadata, not FX depreciation, real rates, official reserves, fixed asset allocation or ETF price/volume. Economic overlap with macro risk and prior gold candidates remains; statistical independence is not claimed.
input: Revised Caldara-Iacoviello Recent Geopolitical Threats index GPRT, 1985-based recent series; no GPR_OLD, historical GPRHT, realized-acts or AI substitution.
decision_clock: At 00:00 Asia/Shanghai on calendar day 15 of each decision month, freeze the current month's monthly vintage file. Trade no earlier than the first verified CN exchange opening on or after that day. Final research terminal is the final CN session of 2025; no 2026 ETF prices or outcomes.
source_version_rule: Use gpr_archive_files/data_gpr_export_YYYYMM.xls in the author-linked iacoviel/iacoviel.github.io repository. Retrieve complete path history and choose the latest path-affecting Git commit with both author and committer timestamps strictly before the decision cutoff; pin and retrieve the file at that full commit SHA. No mutable master, future commit, other month's file, fallback series or interpolated vintage. Inconsistent or incomplete history stays unknown.
publication_assumption: Repository commit metadata provides a conservative version clock conditional on the published repository history being faithful; it is not independent proof of first public availability. Report this limitation. Never substitute the vintage filename month for a publication timestamp.
observation_rule: From the same selected vintage, require finite nonnegative GPRT for the immediately preceding calendar month and all 12 months before it, with unique consecutive monthly dates. Latest target month must be exactly previous calendar month; a later observation is excluded, a missing required observation makes the decision unknown. Preserve all source values; no cross-vintage revision mixing.
signal: Select gold iff previous-month GPRT is strictly above the median of its preceding 12 monthly GPRT values in that same vintage. The median is the arithmetic mean of the two middle values. Equal is known cash; any failed source requirement is unknown cash. This annual trailing comparison is scale-invariant and is not fitted to returns.
holding_rule: Consecutive selected decision months form one source episode. Enter only at its first eligible opening, exit at first nonselected decision opening, at the 252-session cap or at the 2025 terminal. A canceled entry is not retried within the same episode. Max-hold liquidation waits for a new source episode before re-entry. Risk exits and permanent stop rules remain causal and unchanged.
later_slice: 2024-01 through 2025-12: historical stability/validation slice. Earlier gold outcomes and broad 2024 gold background were already exposed; no claim of genuinely blind market knowledge or real forward evidence.
account_if_cadence_passes: Separate one-use admission required. Before market outcome access, bind comparison_policy, sessions, strategy_cycles, statistical implementation and all code/data pins. Actually run strategy, unconditional same-asset holding and zero-interest cash through comparative_allocation.run_comparison for all nine cost cases; an unused policy file is insufficient.
financial_necessary_conditions: Primary strategy net PnL positive in full and later slices
At least 6 full completed source episodes and 3 new later completed episodes; strictly more than half have positive net PnL in each group
Primary mean calendar-month strategy PnL has positive 95% interval lower bound using 5000 circular moving-block resamples of length 6 months over all 46 months, seed 20260922 and linear quantiles
Primary strategy net PnL exceeds both holding and cash in full and later slices; differences are not automatically risk-adjusted alpha
No fixed position, daily-loss or drawdown necessary-condition failure; terminal positions and entitlements settled

pilot.request_order: For each fixed vintage, path commit history then at most one raw file at the selected eligible commit

failure: Any necessary fixed cadence or financial failure closes this exact hypothesis. Do not change component, sign, threshold, lookback, cutoff, dates, cost case or risk to rescue it. Source-only format repair must preserve failures and the economic rule.
